```{=html}
  const W = 1160, H = 300, L = 64, R = 16, T = 14, B = 44;
  const MON = ['Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec', 'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar'];
  const DOW = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
  function axes(top, ticks) {
    const V = (v) => T + (1 - v / top) * (H - T - B);
    let g = '';
    for (const v of ticks) g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${V(v)}" y2="${V(v)}" stroke="#B9C1C6"/><text x="${L - 10}" y="${V(v) + 6}" text-anchor="end" font-size="17" fill="#333F4A">${v}</text>`;
    g += `<text transform="translate(18 ${(T + H - B) / 2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" fill="#66727C">benzene, µg/m³</text>`;
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${L}" y1="${T}" y2="${H - B}" stroke="#333F4A" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${H - B}" y2="${H - B}" stroke="#333F4A" stroke-width="1.5"/>`;
    return [g, V];
  }
  const line = (xs, X, V, cls) => { let d = '', pen = false; xs.forEach((v, k) => { if (v === null) { pen = false; return; } d += (pen ? 'L' : 'M') + X(k).toFixed(1) + ',' + V(v).toFixed(1); pen = true; }); return `<path d="${d}" fill="none" ${cls}/>`; };
  const bars = (xs, labels, V, pick) => { const s = (W - L - R) / xs.length; return xs.map((v, k) => `<rect x="${L + s * k + s * 0.18}" y="${V(v)}" width="${s * 0.64}" height="${H - B - V(v)}" fill="${pick(k) ? '#E29A2D' : '#0F6E6B'}"/><text x="${L + s * (k + 0.5)}" y="${H - 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#333F4A">${labels[k]}</text><text x="${L + s * (k + 0.5)}" y="${V(v) - 8}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" fill="#1C242B">${v.toFixed(1)}</text>`).join(''); };
  const NOTE = {
    week: 'Monday 4 to Sunday 10 October 2004. Two peaks each working day; a lower, flatter Saturday and Sunday.',
    hour: 'Mean of each hour over the year. Weekdays (amber) rise to about 20 at 08:00 and again in the evening; Sundays (teal) stay low.',
    dow: 'Mean of each day of the week over the year. Sunday is half of a weekday: traffic, not weather.',
    year: 'Monthly means. August is low (holidays); October is the highest. A two-month comparison depends on which months you pick.',
  };
  function draw(s) {
    let g = '', V;
    if (s === 'week') {
      [g, V] = axes(40, [0, 10, 20, 30, 40]);
      const X = (k) => L + (k / 167) * (W - L - R);
      for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) g += `<text x="${X(d * 24 + 12)}" y="${H - 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#333F4A">${DOW[d]}</text><line x1="${X(d * 24)}" x2="${X(d * 24)}" y1="${H - B}" y2="${H - B + 6}" stroke="#333F4A"/>`;
      g += line(D.week, X, V, 'stroke="#0F6E6B" stroke-width="2"');
    } else if (s === 'hour') {
      [g, V] = axes(25, [0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25]);
      const X = (k) => L + (k / 23) * (W - L - R);
      for (let h = 0; h < 24; h += 3) g += `<text x="${X(h)}" y="${H - 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" fill="#333F4A">${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00</text>`;
      g += line(D.hourSun, X, V, 'stroke="#0F6E6B" stroke-width="3"') + line(D.hourWk, X, V, 'stroke="#E29A2D" stroke-width="3.5"');
    } else if (s === 'dow') {
      [g, V] = axes(14, [0, 5, 10]);
      g += bars(D.weekday, DOW, V, (k) => k >= 5);
    } else {
      [g, V] = axes(16, [0, 5, 10, 15]);
      g += bars(D.monthly, MON, V, (k) => k === 4 || k === 6);
    }
    document.getElementById('ts-plot').innerHTML = g;
    document.getElementById('ts-out').textContent = NOTE[s];
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-s]').forEach((b) => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.s === s));
  }
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-s]').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => draw(b.dataset.s)));
  draw('week');
})();
</script>
```

## Activity 1 · Which view answers which question? {#act1 .activity data-hold="true"}

[Pairs · 10 minutes · no computer needed]{.act-label}

```{=html}
<div class="stories" id="views">
  <div class="story"><p>When should the morning shift expect the highest benzene?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Hour of day,</b> weekdays only: about 08:00.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Is a Sunday cleaner than a weekday?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Day of week:</b> 6.0 µg/m³ on Sunday against 10 to 12 on weekdays.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Did benzene drop in August?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Year, by month:</b> 7.0 in August against 10 to 13.5 in the months around it.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Was there an unusual event on Thursday last week?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>One week, hourly.</b> Monthly means cannot show one day.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Is October worse than April?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Both months, as distributions,</b> not two bars. See the next slide.</p></div>
  <div class="story"><p>Is the station getting worse over the year?</p><button type="button">Reveal</button><p class="ans" hidden><b>Daily means over the whole year,</b> and say which months you fit. Session 8.</p></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('views'); if (!root) return;
  root.addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  root.querySelectorAll('.story button').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => { b.hidden = true; b.nextElementSibling.hidden = false; }));
})();
</script>
```
